section: Delegation is not an architecture label
purpose: Make the comparison dimensions and their evaluation questions easier to scan than prose alone.
alt: Classify the task and its authority, not the agent branding.. Discover: Find and compare options. The user makes the external commitment. Examples: Daydream. Test: Are the choices accurate and aligned with the user? Watch: Monitor changes and bring relevant information back. Examples: Yutori Scouts. Test: What is missed, and how much noise reaches the user? Prepare: Turn scattered context into a draft, briefing or plan. Examples: jo · Ohai. Test: Is review easier than doing the task directly? Act within a scope: Change an external system under an explicit task and approval boundary. Examples: Mindtrip · jo. Test: What is approved, what changed and can it be undone?

review_notes: Final review: six native columns, all claim-local references resolve, complete rows in Markdown/MDX, no-JavaScript and print baselines preserved. Chromium checked 1440/390/320px, both themes, Focus, keyboard panning, reset and no-result states. Finance column and pinned identities visually inspected; mobile headers wrap and data columns narrow. Physical AI Company base supports overlapping footprints and category/search intersection. No page overflow, console errors or runtime remote-image requests. Full npm validation passes; pre-existing Nimbus build directive and Pagefind redirect warnings remain.

purpose: Orient readers to broad providers, specialist roles and the main comparison dimensions before the complete company explorer.
alt: Personal AI overview: discover, watch, prepare and act within a scope. Broad platforms span several modes; AI-only versus human-assisted execution is a separate dimension. Permissions, confirmation, receipts and recovery surround the task.

rights_assessment: Independently prompted generated synthesis. No third-party figure, screenshot, proprietary logo or technical report artwork reused. Company names are descriptive text, not endorsed partnerships.
review_notes: Built-in image generation followed by targeted edit; labels, company roles, conceptual arrows, interpretation boundaries and legibility manually reviewed. Lossless WebP is 1536 by 1024. Actual light/dark, desktop/mobile and focus rendering inspected; pan/full-size keyboard access passed. Selected examples do not imply ranking, market share, partnerships or demonstrated outcomes.
